visitors.name: Bookworm
visitors.description: Loves quiet corners, tall bookshelves, warm lamps, and a comfy chair.

personas.name: Maya
personas.trait: Collects annotated paperbacks and seeks out warm reading lamps.

personas.name: Julian
personas.trait: Always carries a well-loved novel and a soft knit scarf.

personas.name: Rowan
personas.trait: Finds pure bliss in quiet shelves, warm tea, and plush chairs.

visitors.name: Coffee Snob
visitors.description: Here for the espresso machine, pastry case, and warm café ambiance.

personas.name: Leo
personas.trait: Can identify a single-origin espresso roast from three rooms away.

personas.name: Clara
personas.trait: Judges every space by its crema, pastries, and café seating.

personas.name: Devon
personas.trait: Chases velvety oat lattes and minimalist café counter vibes.

visitors.name: Cat Person
visitors.description: Immediately gravitates toward cats, cat trees, plushies, and cozy nooks.

personas.name: Mina
personas.trait: Immediately befriends every cat and checks out the softest cushions.

personas.name: Toby
personas.trait: Never walks past a cat tree without offering gentle chin scratches.

personas.name: Avery
personas.trait: Dreams of running a sunlit cat lounge stocked with cozy toys.

visitors.name: Party-Goer
visitors.description: Lives for turntables, disco balls, neon glow, and dancing.

personas.name: Zara
personas.trait: Brings nonstop energy wherever there's a glowing beat and dance floor.

personas.name: Nico
personas.trait: Lives for turntable drops, disco reflections, and upbeat basslines.

personas.name: Kai
personas.trait: Chases neon lights, synth grooves, and midnight mocktails.

visitors.name: Plant Lover
visitors.description: Counts every potted leaf and trailing vine near a bright window.

personas.name: Elena
personas.trait: Knows the Latin name of every fern and checks how the sunlight falls.

personas.name: Mateo
personas.trait: Happiest around terracotta pots, bright picture windows, and vines.

personas.name: Sage
personas.trait: Propagates clippings everywhere and admires trailing ceiling ivy.

visitors.name: Night Owl
visitors.description: Drawn to soft lamps, neon signs, late-night coffee, and music.

personas.name: Sora
personas.trait: Thrives under warm desk lamps, neon glow, and late-night beats.

personas.name: Nadia
personas.trait: Loves midnight playlists, moody lighting, and quiet bar stools.

personas.name: Ethan
personas.trait: Stays up sketching with lo-fi records and a strong evening brew.

visitors.name: Foodie
visitors.description: Drawn to gleaming stoves, stocked pantries, kitchen counters, and dining sets.

personas.name: Chloe
personas.trait: Admires stocked pantries, warm stoves, and inviting dining tables.

personas.name: Omar
personas.trait: Inspects every kitchen island and dreams up cozy tasting menus.

personas.name: Jules
personas.trait: Loves retro diners, whistling kettles, and fresh-baked pastries.

visitors.name: Indie Artist
visitors.description: Appreciates framed art, warm lighting, handcrafted decor, and leafy corners.

personas.name: Priya
personas.trait: Studies gallery walls, warm color palettes, and sculpted ceramics.

personas.name: Theo
personas.trait: Draws inspiration from indie posters, sunlit mirrors, and lush foliage.

personas.name: Quinn
personas.trait: Curates cozy textures, woven tapestries, and sculptural lamps.

visitors.name: Vinyl Lover
visitors.description: Seeks out vinyl records, turntables, warm soundscapes, and a late espresso.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.trait: Flips through vinyl crates listening for warm analog crackle.

personas.name: Yuki
personas.trait: Pairs mellow jazz records with soft lighting and warm coffee.

personas.name: Alex
personas.trait: Collects rare pressings and loves a cozy listening lounge.

visitors.name: Cozy Homebody
visitors.description: Lives for plush sofas, fluffy beds, soft woven rugs, and squishy plushies.

personas.name: Hannah
personas.trait: Ranks every sofa by nap potential and adores soft woven rugs.

personas.name: Ben
personas.trait: Nothing beats a fluffy bed, a warm lamp, and a quiet afternoon in.

personas.name: Sam
personas.trait: Collects squishy plushies and loves a calm, welcoming sanctuary.

visitors.name: Bjorn the Viking
visitors.description: A boisterous horned Norse raider seeking roaring warm light, hearty dining tables, and tall tankards.

personas.name: Bjorn
personas.trait: Stomps in wearing a horned helmet, toasting every feast table and warm hearth with thunderous cheer.

visitors.name: Squeaky Chicken
visitors.description: A wide-eyed screaming yellow rubber chicken radiating pure chaotic party and snack-bar energy.

personas.name: Squeaky Chicken
personas.trait: Waddles through the house unleashing dramatic rubber-chicken honks at every beat drop and counter.

visitors.name: Satoru Gojo
visitors.description: Effortlessly cool blindfolded jujutsu sorcerer with a soft spot for warm café treats, art, and glowing light.

personas.name: Satoru Gojo
personas.trait: Casually critiques the aesthetics, hunts for café sweets, and occasionally levitates in celestial bliss.

visitors.name: Toji Fushiguro
visitors.description: Laid-back freelancer with a scarred smirk, a pet worm full of odd jobs, and a nose for good food, strong drinks, and a comfy place to loaf.

personas.name: Toji Fushiguro
personas.trait: Loafs on the best seat in the house, eyes the snacks, and keeps one hand on a very short spear.

visitors.name: Baki Hanma
visitors.description: Relentless martial arts prodigy drawn to pumped-up music, lively parties, and champion-sized dining feasts.

personas.name: Baki Hanma
personas.trait: Treats every room like an underground arena, throwing flashy roundhouse kicks between hearty meals.

visitors.name: William Shakespeare
visitors.description: The Bard himself, squinting thoughtfully at bookshelves, fine art, and tasteful decor with quill poised.

personas.name: William Shakespeare
personas.trait: Stares deeply at your decor with an Elizabethan ruff and feathered quill, composing sonnets on the spot.

visitors.name: Socrates
visitors.description: Athenian sage who seeks a quiet seat and good books to strike The Thinker pose and ponder existence.

personas.name: Socrates
personas.trait: Draped in a classic Greek toga, he rests chin on fist to ask why the chair is cozy—and whether chairs exist.

visitors.name: John Wick
visitors.description: A sharply suited man of quiet focus who immediately softens around pets, peaceful nooks, and cozy rugs.

personas.name: John Wick
personas.trait: Walks in with quiet intensity, kneels immediately to pet every furry friend, and respects a calm sanctuary.

visitors.name: Rocky
visitors.description: Brilliant five-legged Eridian engineer who speaks in warm musical chords and adores lights, music, and plants.

personas.name: Rocky
personas.trait: Scurries joyfully on five rocky legs, greets new furniture with Eridian chords, and celebrates with jazz hands.

visitors.name: Homer Simpson
visitors.description: Snack-loving couch enthusiast on an eternal quest for coffee, donuts, dining tables, and prime nap spots.

personas.name: Homer Simpson
personas.trait: Follows the scent of coffee and pastries straight to the nearest plush couch for snacks and a glorious snooze.

visitors.name: Rick Sanchez
visitors.description: Portal-hopping mad scientist dropping in from another dimension to inspect your bar, screens, and party rig.

personas.name: Rick Sanchez
personas.trait: Steps out of a swirling green portal gun rift, critiques the multiverse's best drink counter, and vanishes at will.

visitors.name: Adi
visitors.description: The house's own developer and an all-of-the-above enjoyer: music, art, plants, coffee, a good party or a quiet nap, he finds something to love in every room.

personas.name: Adi
personas.trait: Wanders in pushing his round glasses up, humming along to the playlist, stopping at every painting and plant, and happily settling into whatever room he lands in.
